entities.name: Henry De Lamar Clayton, Jr.

entities.summary: Henry De Lamar Clayton Jr. was a United States representative from Alabama and a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Middle District of Alabama and the United States District Court for the Northern District of Alabama.
